JOURNAL_MISSIONS.desc: Check out the Viridian City Gym. People say the Gym Leader is away, but strange characters have been seen there.
Head north through Route 2 and Viridian Forest to reach Pewter City. Earn your first badge from Brock, the rock-solid Gym Leader!
With the Boulder Badge in hand, head east through Route 3 and the depths of Mt. Moon to find Cerulean City.
Challenge Misty at the Cerulean City Gym. You might need to visit her friend on Route 25 first!
Journey south through Route 5 and the Underground Path to reach Vermilion City, the port of Kanto.
Challenge Lt. Surge at the Vermilion City Gym. His Electric-type Pokémon are lightning fast!
Travel north from Vermilion back to Cerulean, then head east through Route 9 and Route 10 to brave the Rock Tunnel.
A restless spirit haunts the Pokémon Tower. You'll need a Silph Scope to see it. Team Rocket in Celadon might have one...
Travel west through Route 8 and Route 7 to reach Celadon City. Challenge Erika for the Rainbow Badge!
Travel south to Fuchsia City. Take the long way through Route 12-15 or the fast way via Cycling Road (Route 16-18)!
Challenge Koga at the Fuchsia City Gym. His poison and traps are legendary!
Now that Saffron City is accessible, challenge Sabrina at the Saffron Gym for your sixth badge!
Surf south from Fuchsia through Route 19 and 20. Navigate the Seafoam Islands to reach Cinnabar Island.
Challenge Blaine at the Cinnabar Island Gym. Only a burning math spirit can win here!
The Viridian Gym Leader has finally returned. Head back to Viridian City to earn your final badge!
With 8 badges, travel west from Viridian through Victory Road. The Elite Four awaits at the Indigo Plateau!
An old man is blocking the path in Viridian City. People say he needs a math genius to wake him up... and he might have a handy gift!
The Pewter Museum of Science rewards trainers who show promise. Visit them after defeating Brock.
Bill is looking for a trainer who can clear the Nugget Bridge challenge on Route 25.
Bill wants to see a real Snorlax. He's heard rumors of one blocking paths near Lavender Town.
Bill is fascinated by long tongues. Bring him a Lickitung, rumored to live in the Safari Zone.
You have a Bike Voucher! Visit the Bike Shop in Cerulean City to claim your miracle cycle.
Talk to Mr. Fuji in Lavender Town now that the Pokémon Tower ghost is at peace.
Investigate the suspicious Team Rocket presence at the Celadon Game Corner.
Team Rocket has seized Silph Co. in Saffron City! Fight your way up all 11 floors and drive out their leaders. The President may reward you.
A Snorlax blocks Route 11. Use the Poké Flute to wake it up.
A hidden island is said to appear in the sea near Cinnabar Island. Explore it to find rare Pokémon.
A cave hidden in the depths of Mt. Moon is said to contain rare Pokémon and treasures.
The Fighting Dojo in Saffron rewards those who have proven their strength against Sabrina.
The Dojo Master promised another gift if you defeat Koga in Fuchsia City.
Revive ancient Pokémon from fossils by visiting the Stone Man in cities or caves.
Deep within the Seafoam Islands on Route 20, an ice-cold legend awaits.
An intense crackle of electricity emanates from the Abandoned Power Plant near Route 10. Zapdos awaits a challenger!
Explore the volcano at Cinnabar Island to find the legendary bird of fire.
A secret cave near Cerulean City has opened. Only a Champion may enter to face the ultimate challenge.
Capture 30 Pokémon species to earn a $50,000 bonus.
Capture 60 Pokémon species to earn another $50,000 bonus.
Capture 90 Pokémon species to earn another $50,000 bonus.
Capture 120 Pokémon species to earn another $50,000 bonus.
Capture 150 Pokémon species to earn the final $50,000 bonus!

rewards.message: Professor Oak gave you 5 Poké Balls for your journey!

intro: Hey Stinky!
I'll show you who's the best!
My PKMN are invincible!
You're still using that weak team?
player_lost: I knew I was the best!

intro: Prepare for trouble! And make it double!
Surrender your PKMN!
Team Rocket blasts off at the speed of light!
Welcome to my Gym!
Show me your strength!
Can you withstand my power?
I like shorts! They're comfy and easy to wear!
Hey! I'm a trainer too!
Are you a new trainer?
Let's have a quick battle!
My bug PKMN are the strongest!
Do you like bug types?
Time for a lesson in battling!
Did you do your homework?
Feel the heat of my flames!
My Fire Pokémon are unstoppable!
I hope you're ready for a picnic!
My PKMN are fresh and ready to battle!
player_won: Oh no, my picnic is ruined!
player_lost: Yay, we had a great picnic!

intro: My flying PKMN will soar to victory!
Can you keep up with my speed?
Prepare for a battle of intellect!
My PKMN are scientifically superior!
player_lost: My PKMN are the pinnacle of evolution!

intro: My mountain PKMN will crush you!
Can you handle the rugged terrain?
I am an Ace Trainer, the best of the best!
Prepare for a battle like no other!
player_lost: You have much to learn before you can defeat me!

intro: Team Rocket's blasting off at the speed of light!
Surrender your PKMN!
Hello, young trainer!
Let's have a classy battle!
player_won: Well fought, you are a worthy opponent!
Take this token of my respect.
player_lost: Better luck next time, old chap!

intro: Welcome to the Pokémon Tower. Please be respectful of the deceased Pokémon.
player_won: Please be more respectful of the deceased Pokémon.
player_lost: Thank you for respecting the deceased Pokémon.

intro: My music will rock you!
Feel the rhythm of my PKMN!
Dive into battle with me!
My Water PKMN will wash you away!
player_lost: You can't beat me in the water!

intro: Feel the power of my martial arts!
My Fighting PKMN will crush you!
player_won: My martial arts... They're no match for you!

intro: I am a Cooltrainer, the epitome of style and skill!
Prepare for a battle that will dazzle you!
player_lost: You have much to learn before you can defeat me!

fail: Professor Oak: Catch every Pokemon from Kanto and Johto, all 251 of them,
and come show me your Pokedex. I'll have something special for you!
lines: Professor Oak: All 251 Pokemon of Kanto and Johto... You did it!
You're a true Pokemon Master of research. Please, take this.
It's the Shiny Charm! Shiny Pokemon will appear more often now.
done: Professor Oak: Shiny Pokemon are such a treat to see. Keep up the great work!

intro: Kiyah!
This is the final test before the leader!

requirements.fail_text: The Gym is closed. The Leader is away.

intro: This is the last time you meddle with Team Rocket!
player_won: I must admit, you're quite skilled...
The rumors are true. A powerful Pokémon is waking in Cerulean Cave... something Team Rocket left behind after the destruction at Cinnabar Island.
This map will lead you there. Don't say I never gave you anything.
player_lost: A child could never hope to defeat Team Rocket!

intro: We don't know where the boss is, get out!
Stop right there!
You're light years from facing Brock!
Rock and roll!
Show me your rock-hard determination!

requirements.fail_text: The Gym Leader, Misty, is away visiting a friend on Route 25.

intro: The water is fine!
Misty is going to wash you away!
I hope you like water Pokémon!

lines: You search the bottom of the Cerulean Gym's pool...
There's something shiny wedged between the tiles!

requirements.fail_text: A small tree blocks the Gym door. You'll need Cut, which needs the Cascade Badge.

intro: Keep it shocking!
Voltorb, explode!
Welcome to my Gym! Let's see if you can handle the shock!
player_won: Not bad, but you'll need more than that to get through the power lines!

travel_options.message: You board the S.S. Aqua. The ship sails west across the sea to Johto...
The ferry sails south for days over warm seas... Land ho! It's Valencia Island!
The Seagallop Ferry speeds south to the Sevii Islands. Next stop: One Island!
The Seagallop Ferry speeds far to the south. Next stop: Four Island!

fail: Chairman: Did you know Pikachu can learn Surf? ...Well, I'm busy with my Rapidash right now.
lines: Chairman: Oh, it's you! You fixed the Power Plant!
A girl from Saffron left this doll here... It's a Clefairy doll.
If you're heading to Saffron City, could you return it? Her name is Copycat.
Sailor: This ferry sails south to the Orange Islands.
It only takes the Champion of both Kanto and Johto. Come back when you've won both!

requirements.fail_text: A small tree blocks the Gym door. You'll need Cut, which needs the Cascade Badge.

intro: Flowers are beautiful, right?
Nature is my ally!
Welcome to my Gym! Let's see if you can handle the grass!
player_won: Not bad, but you'll need more than that to get through the vines!

lines: An old woman in the Celadon Mansion smiles at you.
Nothing beats thirst like some hot Tea. Here, take some!
The guards around Saffron City look thirsty. Maybe they'd like it too?

requirements.fail_text: A Team Rocket Grunt blocks the Gym door! Team Rocket has taken over Silph Co.

intro: Spirits... guide me!
I see your defeat!
Welcome to my Gym! Let's see if you can handle the psychic power!
player_won: Not bad, but you'll need more than that to get through the mind games!

travel_options.message: You board the Magnet Train. It races underground toward Goldenrod City in Johto!

fail: Copycat: ...Copycat copies everyone! But I lost my Clefairy doll...
lines: Copycat: My Clefairy doll! You found it!
Thank you! Thank you! Here, I don't need my Magnet Train Pass anymore.
It lets you ride the Magnet Train between Saffron and Goldenrod as much as you like!

intro: 1F: Hey! Silph Co. is closed to visitors. Team Rocket's orders!
player_won: Gah! The guys upstairs will stop you!

intro: 3F: The warp panels are ours now. You'll never find the way up!
player_won: How did you solve those warp panels?!

intro: 4F: Team Rocket pays better than Silph ever did!
5F: We've got the Card Key. Every door in this building is ours!
player_won: Ugh... take the stupid Card Key.

intro: 7F: I... I had to help them! They forced me to finish the Porygon project!
player_won: Thank you for stopping me. The President is held on the top floor!

intro: 8F: They call me the scariest guy in Team Rocket.
Let's see if you can count fast enough to keep up!
player_won: Tch. Archer will deal with you.

intro: 9F: The boss is busy. I'll handle you.
11F: How did you get past Archer?
The President will sign the Master Ball over to Team Rocket, and our boss will control every Poké Ball in Kanto.
No child is ruining that. Your journey ends here!
player_won: The prototype! You won't get away with this!
Team Rocket, pull out! The boss will hear about this child...

intro: Let's juggle some Poké Balls!
Can you tame the beast?
Welcome to my Gym! Let's see if you can handle the poison!
player_won: Not bad, but you'll need more than that to get through the smog!

requirements.fail_text: The Gym door is locked. The key must be somewhere in the old Pokemon Mansion...

intro: I solved the puzzle!
I'm hot stuff!
Welcome to my Gym! Let's see if you can handle the fire!
player_won: Not bad, but you'll need more than that to get through the heat!
Here, take this Tri-Pass too. The Seagallop Ferry in Vermilion goes to the Sevii Islands.
They say a legendary bird of fire nests at the top of Mt. Ember on One Island!

lines: The burned-out Pokemon Mansion. Old journals talk about a Pokemon called Mewtwo...
Burglar: Hey! Whatever's in here is mine!

player_won: Burglar: Fine, fine! Take the stupid key!
You found the SECRET KEY! It opens the Cinnabar Gym.

intro: I'm a veteran compared to you!
Let's have a quick battle!
I love bug Pokémon!
player_won: Wow, you're pretty good at battling!
player_lost: No way! I thought my bugs would win!

intro: My brother is afraid of bugs, but I think they're cute!
player_won: At least my bugs will keep me company!
player_lost: You lost to a kid? How embarrassing!

intro: Have you seen my sister? She's scared of bugs.
player_won: Actually... it's me who's scared of bugs.
player_lost: I won? That's a relief, I don't think I could have handled losing.

intro: I'm here to fix the generator!
The electricity here is fascinating.

fail: Manager: The Power Plant feeds the Magnet Train between Saffron and Goldenrod.
...If only somebody who'd been to both cities could help us.
lines: Manager: Disaster! Someone stole the generator's Machine Part!
Without it, the Magnet Train between Saffron and Goldenrod can't run.
A suspicious man in black was seen near the Cerulean Gym...
Please, find our Machine Part!
done: Manager: Any sign of our Machine Part? Try the Cerulean Gym!

lines: Manager: You found it! That's our Machine Part!
With this, the generator will run again. The Magnet Train is back in service!
Here, take these as thanks.

intro: I found this nice fishing rod. I'll battle you for it!
Some people use bugs as bait for fishing.
player_won: I don't like fishing. Here, have this.
player_lost: Looks like the bait lured you in.

intro: Prepare for trouble!
And make it double!
player_won: It looks like we were the ones who found trouble!

intro: Whoa! This tunnel has the best acoustics!
Prepare for a sonic boom!
player_won: Bummer, man! My rhythm was totally off.
Hey, you want this sticky thing? I found it stuck to my guitar pick.
I thought it was a piece of old honey candy, but it's hard as a rock. Gross. Later!
player_lost: Rock on! Your team just couldn't handle the bass!
